Name: Animated Tools and Weapons
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Animated Tools and Weapons
[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]Adds animations to a bunch of weapons, tools and stuff.
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/jbEMl51.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/TWlkOxF.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/xBCSjG5.gif[/img][/center]Weapons: [spoiler]
- Dark Sword
- Forest Sword
- Galaxy Sword / Dagger / Hammer
- Infinity Blade / Dagger / Hammer (2 versions each)
- Insect Head
- Lava Katana
- Neptune's Glaive
- Obsidian Edge (2 versions)
- Steel Smallsword
- Templar's Sword (2 versions) [/spoiler]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/V9TDKxU.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Hd9lONI.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/6YdSmrT.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zqWeaRT.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/RNOpRJL.gif[/img][/center]Tools: [spoiler]
- Golden Scythe (renamed Prismatic Scythe, this rename only works for newly spawned scythes. Translated to all languges)
- Return Scepter
- All the Prismatic Tools, including sprinkler & bar[/spoiler]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/E47ybre.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/yWJ5pFw.gif[/img][/center][/size][u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
﻿[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][/size]
[size=3]-  and Prismatic Tools (Optional, link in requirements)[/size]
[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)[/size]

[u][size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size][/u][size=3]All the animations are configurable, some have different versions. Check the config.json, I highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[/size][b][u][size=5]Extra
[/size][/u][/b][size=3]If you have recommendations or comments, let me know. I will probably update this mod as I come up with new ideas for animations.
The Prismatic Scythe name change will only work for newly spawned scythes. So if you're installing this mod on an old save, the only way to get the name changed is to cheat in a new scythe.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/RuxuoHg.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/eCHhyps.gif[/img][/center][/size]
